topic: Would you trust a robot home alone? What home humanoids have actually shown
hook: Would you leave THIS robot home alone?
voiceover: Would you leave this robot home alone? Figure sent its humanoid into thirty homes it had never seen. Towels, beds, toys. It finished the whole job fifty-six percent of the time. When it missed, it stepped back and tried again. Another robot, 1X's NEO, lets owners book a remote human for new chores. So who's really home?

beats.narration: Would you leave this robot home alone?
Figure sent its humanoid into thirty homes it had never seen.
Towels, beds, toys. It finished the whole job fifty-six percent of the time. When it missed, it stepped back and tried again.
Another robot, 1X's NEO, lets owners book a remote human for new chores.

shots.visual: Robot mid-fold snaps a towel open in a sunlit living room; front door opens behind it; host steps in.
Over the host's shoulder: he sets his keys down and watches the robot stack the towel and turn its head to him.
Close-up of robot fingers pinching towel corners together; rack focus to the host leaning in.
Tracking: the robot drops toys into a basket; one bounces off the rim and rolls away; the robot steps back.
Orbit: the robot shifts its stance, re-grips the toy and drops it in; walks to the open dishwasher and pauses, eye lights turning amber.
Match cut on the amber light: a person in a VR headset in a quiet remote workroom slowly reaches forward with hand controllers.
Push out of the headset lens into the living room: the robot sets a plate in the rack; the host turns to camera and asks the question.

key_visual_moment: A toy slips from the robot's hand, it steps back, re-grips and finishes the job.
do_not_depict: Figure, Figure 03, 1X or NEO logos, names on the robot, or either company's exact robot design
The robot doing chores the sources don't describe (cooking, childcare, caring for a person)
The remote operator as a spy or watching the family; no screens showing camera feeds of people
A flawless run implied as typical: the toy miss stays in the cut
The host pointing at the robot or at text
